_doc_truoc: Cau hinh he tu chay `q`. Moi khoa o day de trong thi lay mac dinh trong
qwen/cau_hinh.py. Sua file nay KHONG can sua code.
muc_tieu_cpu la % cua CA MAY, khong phai % rieng cua he nay. Khi MT5 tester
an 60% thi lan CPU tu co lai - do la hanh vi dung. Muon chay mot lan voi muc
khac ma khong sua file: `QWEN_CPU=70 q` (hoac set QWEN_CPU=70 tren cmd).
_ghi_chu_tran_lan: TESTER = 1 la RANG BUOC VAT LY, dung nang len. `chay_tester_kho` ghi de cung
mot MQL5/Experts/<TEN_EA>.mq5, cung mot .ini, cung mot .xml, va may chi co
MOT terminal64.exe. Hai viec tester chay cung luc thi ghi de ket qua cua nhau
va KHONG AI BAO LOI - bang so doc y het mot ket qua that.
_ghi_chu_mo_hinh: Khoa doc TAI CHO tu ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db, khong chep sang day.
`cc_switch_provider` khop bang CHUOI CON voi cot `name`. Lech ten = ca duong
LLM tat lang le (06/09: moi loi goi tra 'thieu OPENAI_API_KEY').
Goi THANG api.ai-box.vn, khong qua cau noi 127.0.0.1:8317 - cau noi do dung
cho Codex CLI (doi /v1/responses). Do 08/09: thang 2,1s vs qua cau noi 3,2s.
Dat `qua_cau_noi: true` neu muon ep di qua cau noi de xem log tung loi goi.
Chon qwen3.7-flash bang PHEP DO (khai bao QUA duoc cong ngu phap / gia), khong
bang ten: 5/6 file, 8 khai bao, ~160 dv moi khai bao giu duoc.
